sections.heading: Do British citizens need an Uganda visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Uganda, applied for online as an eVisa before travelling.

sections.heading: Uganda visa for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way. The East Africa Tourist Visa, covering Uganda, Rwanda and Kenya, is also an option.

sections.heading: Before you travel to Uganda
sections.text: You'll need proof of yellow fever vaccination. Have your passport scan, photo and itinerary ready, and print your eVisa approval to show on arrival.

sections.heading: Uganda visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Uganda visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Uganda.

faqs.q: Do I need a visa for Uganda from the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. British citizens apply online for an Uganda eVisa before travelling.

faqs.q: Do I need a yellow fever certificate for Uganda?
faqs.a: Yes, proof of yellow fever vaccination is normally required.

faqs.q: How long does an Uganda visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
